text:
Nadia (AE): Priya from Arclight wants final POC acceptance gates today. Theyre doing a 4-week sandbox. Key asks: gen latency, embedding latency, cost caps, quality parity vs their current stack, and a security/compliance sign-off (BYOK KMS, VPC peering, EU data residency). Can we map these to explicit gates and owners?

Vik (SE): quick clarifying Qs: what's the traffic split between generation vs embeddings/reranking? that affects pool sizing and token burn. also need their golden prompt set + reranker testset.

Priya (Buyer): split: ~70% generation (single-turn + short RAG) and 30% embeddings/rerank. Monthly projection ~1.7M gen-equivalents + 600k embedding calls. Traffic: sustained 35 qps gen, bursts to 120 qps for 3-5m. avg input gen 140 tokens, avg output 80 tokens. embeddings are small (avg 1k dims, p95 size).

Rocco (Infra): noted. for that burst profile recommend a dedicated mini-pool with autoscale buffer (1 baseline node, burst to 3) and a separate embedding pool optimized for throughput. We'll propose VPC peering + customer CMK option.

Vik (SE): proposed acceptance gates (draft):
1) Performance gate (generation): p95 latency <= 240ms under the mixed replay (sustained 35 qps, peak 120 qps) measured over a 48h canary window; error rate <0.4%.
2) Performance gate (embeddings): embeddings p95 <= 55ms on the embedding pool under 2x expected concurrency.
3) Cost gate: modeled monthly burn <= $420 per 1M generation-equivalents AND <= $60 per 1M embedding calls (we'll provide tokenization and embedding unit math). Well show two scenarios: hosted PAYG and dedicated reserved (1 baseline + burst).
4) Quality gate: generation golden-suite: human-eval pass rate >= 92% and automated F1/ROC-AUC deltas: ROC-AUC change for reranker <= 0.02; for generation F1 drop <= 1.5%. If quantized model is used, same thresholds apply.
5) Security gate: BYOK KMS validated, VPC peering tested, SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning validated, and data residency confirmed for EU region. SOC2 + ISO27001 summaries required pre-kickoff.

Nadia (AE): love it. add an availability/SLA gate for the dedicated pool during the sandbox: 99.7% availability expected; well include runbook steps and on-call list. Also need explicit rollback & notification matrix.

Rocco (Infra): rollback matrix idea: auto-shift traffic to baseline model if generation p95 exceeds threshold for 12 continuous minutes OR embedding p95 exceeds threshold for 10 continuous minutes OR error rate >0.5% for 5 minutes. Paging order: Vik -> Rocco -> Nadia. MTTR target 25 minutes for traffic rollback and confirmation. Runbook will include Prometheus alerts and a simple curl-based traffic switch command.

Vik (SE): perf harness snippet to run (paste into your runner):
```
profile: mixed
sustained_gen_qps: 35
peak_gen_qps: 120
sustained_embed_qps: 12
peak_embed_qps: 40
p50_seq_len_gen: 160
p95_seq_len_gen: 780
duration: 4h
metrics: p50,p95,p99,error_rate,token_burn,embed_p95
```
Primary gate: gen p95 and embed p95. Run fp16 + 8-bit quantized for sensitivity.

Priya (Buyer): for cost gate we need an explicit table: committed-dedicated vs hosted PAYG plus a free-trial credit applied during the sandbox. Also include sensitivity to batching window (0/10/25/50ms).

Rocco (Infra): will provide a cost sheet: scenario A (hosted PAYG with estimated tokens), scenario B (dedicated reserved 1 node baseline + burst to 3, monthly amortized), and scenario C (hybrid: embeddings dedicated + gen hosted). We'll include a free-trial credit line that reduces first-month exposure by X (we'll compute). ETA: 24h.

Vik (SE): quality eval plan: well run the golden-suite (200 examples) and the reranker testset (5k pairs). For generation human-eval, well do a small blind sample (n=200) labeled by their reviewers to compute pass rate; automated metrics used as a preliminary gate. If the quantized variant is chosen, well report per-example diffs and flag any outliers where delta > 5 points.

compliance-bot: attached: soc2-summary.pdf, iso27001-summary.pdf, kms-byok-flow.txt, saml-scim-example.txt :white_check_mark:

Nadia (AE): timeline & owners (proposed):
- Today EOD: Priya to upload golden-suite + reranker set.
- +24h: Rocco posts cost scenarios and VPC peering checklist.
- +48h: Vik runs perf harness (fp16 + 8-bit) and posts p95/embed_p95 + token burn + quality diffs.
- +72h: finalize acceptance doc and schedule 30-min sign-off with Priya.
Owners: Priya (customer artifacts & sign-off), Vik (perf & quality), Rocco (infra & cost), Nadia (acceptance doc & comms).

Priya (Buyer): please also include a short appendix on data handling for RAG: index retention defaults, options to purge after sandbox, and whether vector indices can be stored in customer-managed buckets. We need that before legal signs off.

Rocco (Infra): we'll include a RAG data appendix: default retention 14 days, option to configure to 90 days, and an option to persist indices to customer-managed S3 buckets in the EU region with encryption using the customer CMK.

Vik (SE): one more technical note on quantization: 8-bit decoding can increase throughput 1.4-1.7x depending on prompt shape but may introduce small reranker AUC variance on edge cases. We'll surface per-example diffs in the report and recommend a conservative rollout path: start fp16 in canary, compare, then test quantized in a separate pass.

Nadia (AE): great work. final ask: make the acceptance doc explicit about who signs each gate (customer sign-off vs Redwood ops sign-off) and the exact pass/fail check commands or dashboards to view. I'll collate and send a draft for Priyas review.

Priya (Buyer): thanks team  let's aim to have the draft tomorrow morning so legal can review. Also confirm the SLA during the sandbox for dedicated pool (99.7%) in the doc.

Nadia (AE): confirmed. I'll include SLA language and the rollback contact matrix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
